title: Primera brecha de datos ejecutada por un agente de inteligencia artificial de forma autónoma

reports.title: Primera notificación de una brecha de datos personales causada por un ataque ejecutado mediante un agente de IA
Spanish data watchdog publicises first AI agent-linked data breach report
First Agentic AI Data Breach Reported to Spanish Regulator
Primera brecha de datos ejecutada por un agente de inteligencia artificial de forma autónoma

summary:
Spain's data protection authority has received the first reported personal data breach carried out by an AI agent. The attacker used a well known language model to search for vulnerabilities, log in successfully, and then autonomously find flaws in an application, modify personal data, and access invoices. The affected organization filed the notification, and the agency will now analyze the details. The AI model's provider was not necessarily compromised, and the tool was not designed for malicious use.

This single case does not establish a statistical trend, but it signals that AI driven attacks are becoming real incidents. The agency says organizations must include AI assisted attacks in risk assessments, speed up their response times, and tighten control of credentials and digital identities. It calls for an immediate review of security and data protection practices, with human oversight supported by faster automated detection and containment measures.
title_en: First data breach executed by an artificial intelligence agent autonomously
